voice_lines: Netflix once offered itself to Blockbuster for fifty million dollars.
It was two thousand. Netflix mailed DVDs, and it was losing millions.
Its founders flew to Dallas to pitch the deal.
One founder says Blockbuster's boss struggled not to laugh. The answer was no.
That year, Blockbuster collected nearly eight hundred million dollars in late fees.
[serious] Ten years later, it filed for bankruptcy.
The whole company sold at auction for about three hundred twenty million.
[dramatic] Netflix today is worth about two hundred forty billion.
The lesson: big profits make small ideas look like jokes.
